column1: # A person's review of the crosswalk for the 18S sample table (make_2L_table.py), as the guide
# describes: confirm a match, change its term, delete the row so the column is not matched, or add
# a row for a column with none. action: confirm | delete | term:<FAIRe term> | add:<FAIRe term>

column3: the fastq file name of each sample (S001_S13_L001), not the sampling device
the number of the filter cartridge, not a read count
a field label for each sample, as sample_title is in the 10 L table
station codes (S2.1, N1.1), not place names; Locality gives geo_loc_name
the date of filtering, not the date the record changed
who filtered each sample, not the people responsible for the dataset
who collected each sample; recordedBy is the person responsible for the dataset, named in project_contact (O. Berry, 13 November 2026)
the planned sampling depth, not the depth of the water column
the depth each sample was taken from (the planned depths in Nominal depth are the same), not the depth of the water column; a commonly confused term, so always for review
the volume of water collected and filtered for each sample (samp_size); a commonly confused term, so always for review
